title: SK Hynix Scraps Solidigm US IPO After Shareholder Concerns
description: SK Hynix Inc. has scrapped plans for a US listing of its Solidigm unit after facing strong shareholder opposition and regulatory scrutiny over concerns that the move could undermine minority investor interests.

title: Trump, Crypto Firm Sued for Profiting Off Foreign Government
description: Donald Trump and World Liberty Financial, the cryptocurrency venture he co-founded with his sons, were sued by a shareholder in a rival crypto firm over claims the president illegally profited from his office in violation of the US Constitution.

title: US Proposes Curbs on Investment in Chinese Biotech Firms
description: The Trump administration is seeking to restrict American investment in Chinese biotechnology companies, potentially complicating financial ties at a time when US drugmakers are increasingly turning to China for new medicines.
